page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-hypermem-16 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the m4n server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 dedicated virtual central processing units and a total memory capacity of 248.0 GB. This configuration yields a high memory-to-core ratio of 15.5 GB of RAM per vCPU, designed specifically for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints relative to compute capacity.

This server type does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. Additionally, the instance does not feature any integrated graphics processing units and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the m4n-hypermem-16 provides high memory density per vCPU, making it a viable option for memory-bound applications that do not require massive parallel CPU processing or local NVMe storage. It is suitable for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
